artikelen.titel: Tehran summons Ukrainian diplomat after Kyiv bombs an Iranian ship
artikelen.beschrijving: Iran has condemned a Ukrainian attack on one of its commercial vessels.

artikelen.titel: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
artikelen.beschrijving: US military says it disabled a tanker that was attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports.

artikelen.titel: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
artikelen.beschrijving: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

artikelen.titel: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
artikelen.beschrijving: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.

artikelen.titel: US military disables tanker accused of breaking the Iran blockade
artikelen.beschrijving: The US military has released footage it says shows forces boarding one tanker.

artikelen.titel: Israeli settlers set fire to mosque in occupied West Bank
artikelen.beschrijving: Israeli settlers set fire to Al-Rahma Mosque in Qusra, near Nablus, as Israeli forces arrested dozens of Palestinians

artikelen.titel: House of Hope: New film follows a Waldorf-inspired school in the West Bank
artikelen.beschrijving: Documentary follows children under occupation and the couple who run a holistic primary school as Israel's war persists.

artikelen.titel: Typhoon Noul makes landfall in China, with hundreds of thousands evacuated
artikelen.beschrijving: Noul hit southern Guangdong province and neighbouring Hong Kong, bringing strong winds and heavy rain to the region.

artikelen.titel: New front in US-Iran war escalates as Houthis fire at Saudi oil facilities
artikelen.beschrijving: Conflict also spreads to Caspian Sea as Tehran accuses Ukraine of a deadly attack on an Iranian vessel.
